verses.83:14: كَلَّاۖ بَلۡۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُواْ يَكۡسِبُونَ

meaning: The root رين (ryn) primarily means to be rusty or dirty. It extends to a soul becoming heavy or nauseous.
